title: 2 * ( DATE ( 2020, 10, 23 ) + TIME ( 12, 0, 0 ) ) is the integer 88255: the half day takes part in the product

source.quote: if a multiplication operation combines an integer with a real number, DAX converts both numbers to real numbers, and the return value is also REAL
source.supports: the multiplication table above this sentence has a Date/time column: INTEGER gives INTEGER, REAL gives REAL. It has no Date/time row

source.quote: VALUE converts a text string that represents a number to a number
source.supports: the example shows DATE ( 2020, 10, 23 ) as the number 44127

derivation: The multiplication table gives INTEGER for an INTEGER multiplied by a Date/time, as in assumptions/integer-times-date. 2020-10-23 12:00 is day 44127.5. The product 2 * 44127.5 = 88255 is a whole number, so as an integer it is 88255.
alternative: If the date multiplies as a decimal number the result is the double 88255.0 (and assumptions/integer-times-date is the double 88254.0). If the date were made an integer before multiplying, the half day would be rounded away and the result would be 88254 or 88256.
notes: The value separates the readings as well as the type: only a product computed on 44127.5 gives 88255.
